Varun Dhawan Praises 'Hanuman Ansh' Biopic, Urges Fans to Watch

Actor Varun Dhawan has praised the recently released biopic 'Hanuman Ansh', calling it a "purely made, amazing experience" and a "divine experience". He urged his fans to watch the film in theatres. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, the movie reportedly traces the spiritual journey of Lakshminarayan towards becoming Neem Karoli Baba. The film has also reportedly crossed Rs 100 crore at the domestic box office. Other Bollywood personalities, including Aditya Dhar, have also reportedly lauded the film.
